identitySignals: Name matches: a business trading as 'Heggerty' (Heggerty Phonemic Awareness, legal name Literacy Resources, LLC) is listed at Oak Park, IL, matching the agenda location 'Oak Park, IL' (Pavilion government-contracts directory; National Head Start Association 'The Junction' listing)

Organization sells a phonemic awareness curriculum for elementary schools, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' services agreement presented by the Chief Academic Officer (Academics and Instruction Department)
Two independent third-party listings (Pavilion and The Junction) give the same Oak Park, IL 60301 address and the heggerty.org website
research.notes: Heggerty's own site (heggerty.org) is a JavaScript app that returns no readable text to automated fetchers, so phone, email and registry IDs could not be verified from it and are left null. Legal name and address come from the Pavilion public-procurement directory; no EIN, California entity number or UEI was confirmed (company is Illinois-based and not a nonprofit).

profile.summary: Heggerty is the trade name of Literacy Resources, LLC, a company in Oak Park, Illinois that publishes a phonemic awareness curriculum for Pre-K through fifth grade. It sells lesson sequences, assessments and a subscription software platform (myHeggerty) with training materials for teachers and school districts.
